description: August 20 birthday meaning: Leo decan 3, birthday number 2, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, an August 20 birthday falls in Leo, in the third decan, with Sun as the sign's ruler and Mars as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 2. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Leo is fixed and fire.

sections.heading: Personality of an August 20 birthday
paragraphs: Late Leo, twenty-seven degrees along, softens on August 20th through the cooperative number 2. Mars still sub-rules the decan, so the energy is warm and active, but it tends to flow into partnership: championing a spouse, a co-founder, a best friend. Traditional readings describe a loyal ally who fights fiercely for the people beside them.

By noon UTC on August 20, the Sun has normally reached roughly 27° of Leo. That places the date in the Leo decan that astrologers give to Mars, the third of three. The final third of Leo sits under Mars, ruler of Aries, and so mid-to-late August birthdays tend to carry the most forceful version of the sign. Courage, competitiveness and a readiness to defend people or principles are commonly associated with this decan. These Leos often lead from the front and prefer action to ceremony. Mars can make the temper quick and the pride prickly, especially when they feel challenged in public. The same fire gives them stamina for long campaigns. Channelling it into a cause bigger than personal recognition is often where this decan does its most memorable work.

sections.heading: Numerology of the August 20 birthday
paragraphs: A birthday on the 20th reduces as 2 + 0 = 2, giving a birthday number of 2. The 0 is often read as amplifying the 2, intensifying its sensitivity, diplomacy and emotional awareness. Those born on the 20th are frequently described as intuitive companions and natural team members, attuned to atmosphere and moods. They may pick up the feeling in a room before anyone has spoken. As a secondary number in the chart, the 20 tends to show in close relationships and group work. Protecting their own energy, and saying no kindly, is a recurring theme for this birthday.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same August 20 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 1 for 1980, 11 for 1990, 3 for 2000 and 4 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: August 20 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: An August birthday falls in late northern summer, a season of early harvests and holidays, and in late winter for the southern hemisphere, when the first blossom starts to appear. Leo holds most of the month, with Virgo arriving around August 22 or 23. August is month 8 in numerology, associated with ambition, authority and material skill, a fitting partner for Leo's confidence. August 20 is the 232nd day of the year (233rd in a leap year). In most years Virgo season is under way by August 23, 3 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for an August 20 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. August 20 is also the birthday of Benjamin Harrison (1833), Demi Lovato (1992) and H. P. Lovecraft (1890).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is August 20?
faq.answer: August 20 is Leo in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the third decan of Leo, which tradition links with Mars.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on August 20?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On August 20 the Life Path is 8 in 1960, 9 in 1970, 1 in 1980, 11 in 1990, 3 in 2000, 4 in 2010 and 5 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 2 for everyone born on the 20th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on August 20?
faq.answer: By August 20 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on August 20?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with an August 20 birthday are Benjamin Harrison (1833), Demi Lovato (1992) and H. P. Lovecraft (1890). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
